_comment: One colour and one marker per arm, used in every figure the arm appears in, so a reader who
has learnt that the production engine is blue never has to relearn it. Eight hues, a validated
categorical palette (light surface; colour-vision-deficiency and normal-vision separation checked
pairwise in each set's legend order) -- never add a ninth, reuse one instead: two arms may share
a hue only if no set in configs/figure_sets.json puts them in the same figure, and
scripts/figure_layout.py refuses to draw a set where two arms collide.
The four kit modes wear the same hues in the OpenFold3 kit and the AlphaFold 3 kit (off violet,
exact yellow, fast aqua, big green): they mean the same thing, and the two kits share no figure.
Hues: blue #2a78d6  orange #eb6834  aqua #1baf7a  yellow #eda100  magenta #e87ba4
`linestyle` is the second identity channel: two arms whose curves coincide (kit off under exact,
big under big with the reach gate off) stay both visible because one of them is dashed.

af3_native.role: AlphaFold 3 code and weights, templates on

af3_openbind.role: AlphaFold 3 code, openbind weights, templates on
